text:
amy: Heads-up: Partner 'BlueBox Cloud' flagged a ~$11k negative adjustment from last month's marketplace export. They think late per-minute deltas were merged into hourly buckets and our rounding rules flipped sign. tagging partners/ops.

ben: can we pull raw minute events for the affected account range? sounds like ordering + merge semantics.

daria: i pulled a sampling. we received increments + periodic full snapshots. snapshots sometime arrive after later increments (7+ hours). our hourly rollup currently applies events in arrival order which can reverse the net.

omar: do snapshots include a sequence id? if yes, we should prefer snapshot when seq>applied_seq.

amy: BlueBox Cloud started sending X-Snapshot-Seq in v2.4, but older customers don't.

ben: quick mitigation idea: if a snapshot timestamp is older than current hour state by >2h, mark it `delayed-snapshot` and hold for manual review. if snapshot_seq present and greater than applied_seq, allow automatic backfill.

daria: long-term: introduce tombstone records keyed by (partner_id, window_start, snapshot_seq) so rollup treats snapshot as canonical and ignores older incrementals. add an idempotent backfill job that recomputes hour windows from snapshot state.

omar: i'll estimate backfill size on 90d sample. also add alerting: if out-of-order ratio >0.4% for any partner over 24h, fire and stop auto-apply.

recon-bot: created ticket PRJ-7012: "bluebox-cloud-snapshot-backfill" assigned to @daria. (https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRJ-7012) :robot_face:

daria: playbook (sketch):
- dry-run backfill computing per-invoice deltas and CSV export for partner review
- partner signoff -> apply compensating adjustments via ledger-service (creates reversing entries)
- emit audit events + notify billing-run and legal

amy: owners + ETA:
- daria: PR for tombstones + dry-run job (ETA 3 days)
- omar: infra cost + alert rule (ETA 1 day)
- ben: ledger-service contract + tests (ETA 3 days)
- amy: partner comms + legal review (ETA 1 day)

ben: unit tests for tombstone precedence and merge ordering mandatory. i'll pair with daria.

amy: i'll schedule a sync with BlueBox Cloud tomorrow 11am PT to present the playbook. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
